name: Temporal Frequency Anomaly
description: Detects anomalous temporal frequency signatures in video — AI generation creates distinctive temporal spectral patterns.
mechanism:
This method detects temporal frequency anomalies for video deepfake detection:

1. **시간적신호추출**: Per-pixel or per-region temporal signals are extracted — tracking intensity, color, and texture over time. These signals capture the temporal dynamics at each spatial location.

2. **시간적주파수분해**: Temporal signals are analyzed via FFT to obtain per-location temporal frequency spectra. This reveals the frequency components of temporal variation: scene motion (~0-5 Hz), lighting changes (~0-1 Hz), and potential generation artifacts.

3. **이상감지in시간적Spectra**: Natural video temporal spectra are dominated by low frequencies (slow scene changes) with rapid falloff at higher frequencies. The method detects anomalous spectral components: (a) energy at incommensurate frequencies with no physical source, (b) spectral peaks at the video generator's characteristic temporal frequencies, (c) unexpected harmonics from repetitive generation patterns.

4. **공간적매핑of시간적Anomalies**: The detected temporal frequency anomalies are mapped spatially. Anomalies concentrated in face regions (but absent in background) strongly indicate face-specific generation artifacts. The spatial distribution of temporal anomalies reveals the extent and boundaries of generated content.

5. **Cross-주파수일관성**: In natural video, temporal frequency components at different spatial frequencies are coherently related (same physical motion produces correlated temporal variations at all spatial frequencies). The method checks cross-frequency coherence — AI generation may produce temporally incoherent variations at different spatial scales.
parameters: 분석 유형: 자동 통계\n점수 범위: 0(실제)~100(AI 생성)
source: 디지털 포렌식 및 AI 콘텐츠 탐지 관련 동료 검토 연구 기반.
useCase: AI 생성 콘텐츠를 탐지하기 위한 다중 신호 분석 파이프라인의 일부로 사용.
strengths: • 연구 기반 방법론\n• 빠른 계산 속도\n• 다른 탐지 방법과 보완적
limitations: • 정확도는 입력 품질에 따라 변동\n• 다른 방법과 함께 사용하는 것이 최적
